steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each station is placed by its job ageing against the limit and whether jobs are blocked.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 job is blocked with no reason

findings.title: Job blocked with no reason
findings.fix: Record the reason and the owner

findings.title: Job older than its station limit
findings.fix: Move the job or clear the blocker

findings.title: Station count does not match its jobs

outcome.notChecked: Physical stock not in the list.

pros: Checks a job older than its station limit, a job blocked with no reason, and a station whose count does not match its jobs.
cons: Not checked: Physical stock not in the list.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-wip-tracking skill on the records for this review.
